_README: CHARACTERIZATION BASELINE for the ai-judge grading path, captured READ-ONLY from the ITERA production database (Supabase project kjefmwlopzeaqgqtlbdn) at the instant in `_capturedAt`. `rows` = every itera.activity_defs and itera.activities row whose `rubric` is non-empty — the exact set that plan 20260807-itera-activity-defs-registry-restructure phase 3e folds into `spec.evaluation`. `verdicts` = every itera.activity_results row whose feedback carries a `criteria` array, i.e. every AI-judge verdict production has ever recorded. REDACTION: `criteria[].note` and `feedback` are model prose ABOUT a real learner submission and are NOT stored — only a boolean saying they were present. The upstream provider `user_id` inside `degradedReason` is masked. `criterion` strings ARE stored: they are the model's paraphrase of the AUTHORED rubric, carry no learner content, and are the evidence that text cannot be a key. `ref` = first 8 chars of the row uuid. Learner ids, submissions and artifacts are not selected at all. Consumed by src/test/judgeGradingBaseline.test.tsx. Regenerate: see scripts/dump-grading-baseline.md.
